terra.problem: The passage does not say how far Solomon sent for Huram.
Saying stone was not Huram’s work goes beyond the text, which describes his skill in bronze but does not rule out stone work.
The passage says Huram completed his work, not that he stayed without leaving until the end.
The joke changes the action from leaving the articles unweighed to counting bronze and giving up.
David did not see the work finished. He died before Solomon completed it (1 Kings 2:10).
The statement that priests serve in the temple is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
Calling the temple treasuries a fancy pantry makes part of the house of the LORD the subject of the joke.
